tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Compression Policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use zstd (Zstandard) as its compression codec, chosen because its compression ratios are markedly better than those of the approach used before. No other compression parameters, such as compression level or dictionary use, are recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It records zstd (Zstandard) as the current compression codec, because its ratios are much better than the previous approach.

The only compression decision in the project's memory is observation #1, from the prompt "Actually switching to zstd, the ratios are way better." No later entry withdraws or replaces it. The file doesn't name the earlier codec.

The record doesn't say the decision applies specifically to transport compression, so the file doesn't either. It also says that no other compression parameters, such as level or dictionary use, are recorded.

My first attempt to write the file through Bash failed to parse, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead.
